explanationMd: Factor x squared−16=(x−4)(x+4). Cancelling x−4 is valid under the given nonzero condition and leaves x+4 on that restricted domain.

distractorRationale.b: The numerator factors into two different factors.
distractorRationale.a: This subtracts four after squaring instead of cancelling the common factor x minus four.
distractorRationale.c: The numerator is not identical to the denominator.
distractorRationale.d: Cancellation removes the common linear factor, not only a constant.
